title: Roy Kim warns future dims if looks trump singing on South Korea's The Ballad of Us 2 - CHOSUNBIZ

Roy Kim warns future dims if looks trump singing on South Korea's The Ballad of Us 2 - CHOSUNBIZ 
 2026년 10월 19일(월) Industry Finance Real Estate IT Retail Science Policy Society International Entertainment Culture Sports English Entertainment Roy Kim warns future dims if looks trump singing on South Korea's The Ballad of Us 2 
 입력 2026.10.13. 08:40 조선비즈 구글 검색 먼저 보기 "The Ballad of Us 2" featured a handsome male contestant.
 On the 12th, SBS' The Ballad of Us 2 (hereinafter The Ballad of Us) held a competition on the theme "a song that made me cry."
 When the contestant appeared, Moon Geun-young's eyes widened and she applauded. At the handsome visuals, other topback-ghosts also cheered. Hearing the cheers, Jun Hyun-moo showed a jealous look, saying, "Does an 'oh' come out as soon as he appears?"
 When the contestant preparing for the stage did not seem nervous, Jun Hyun-moo joked, "I know why he's not nervous. Already half of the female audience is smiling."
 The contestant played guitar and sang himself, and his relaxed attitude matched an outstanding singing ability that made everyone admire him. Jun Hyun-moo even muttered to himself, "It's so good."
 When the song ended, applause broke out. Joo Woo-jae said, "Do you want to see people go crazy?" and then added, "It's like the enemy of men." Roy Kim honestly said, "It doesn't feel like the first time he's tried to make people laugh. When I thought he was trying to be cheesy, I thought, 'Oh, it's jealousy.' I wondered why I was jealous." Joo Woo-jae said, "I pressed it because it felt like losing if I didn't," and Jung Jae-hyung added, "Joo Woo-jae looked the most pathetic."
 Roy Kim said, "The future is a bit unfortunate in one respect. When appearance comes before vocal ability and skill, it takes a really long time and effort to break that perception." In response, Park Kyung-lim asked, "Are you talking about yourself?" Roy Kim laughed shamelessly.
 Moon Geun-young gave the judge's comment, "The voice is my type. I also want to hear an impassioned ballad." She continued, "Behind the soft and sweet voice came a solid voice with a metallic timbre. If you hear an impassioned ballad with that voice..." showing intense fandom. At this forward reaction, Park Kyung-lim asked if she wasn't getting married this year, and Moon Geun-young said, "I will keep him from seeing the groom," prompting laughter.
